title: MD-B12 reference population completed at 75/75 with every remaining row promoted or decided, admitting the stage to DECISION_RECORDED_STAGES
attempt_outcome: COMPLETE - the 39 rows MD-B12-A002 deliberately left behind are resolved: 15 promoted and bound, 24 recorded as reference with their basis. MD-B12 now carries zero non-structural reference rows without a recorded decision.
authority_basis: MD-S012 Corporate Action and Adjustment Policy Selected Defaults (LOCKED): Version/change rule, Coherence rule, One-basis-per-run, Persistence of the binding, Acceptance criterion, Capability boundary scope.

MD-S083 Price Adjustment Contract (LOCKED): Factor provenance vocabulary, Factor revision model, Structural-adjustment formula, Contamination behavior, Price-break detector boundary, Capability boundary.

what_this_completes.a002_left_behind: MD-B12-A002 took Forbidden behavior (LOCKED) and Eligibility for adjustment (LOCKED) only, 15 rows, and recorded 39 as outstanding rather than implying the stage was finished.

promotions.MD-S012 Version/change rule: R0030 to R0034 - an output-affecting change requires a new product/formula/config version, new hashes, recomputation of every affected date from the stable dependency boundary, new publication/correction lineage where prior output was sealed, and long-chain deterministic oracle proof.
promotions.MD-S083 Factor provenance vocabulary: R0006 closed vocabulary mirrored in EventRiskSourceRepository::ADJUSTMENT_SOURCES; R0017 a refused factor still contaminates; R0019 DERIVED_FROM_PRICE_SERIES is refused outright by the importer.
promotions.MD-S083 Factor revision model: R0030 factor rows are append-only and a factor used by a sealed publication cannot be mutated.
promotions.MD-S083 Structural-adjustment formula: R0038 the ordered product of verified structural factor revisions over B < ex_date <= D.
promotions.MD-S083 Contamination behavior: R0048 to R0052 - compute and disclose on a verified active factor, quarantine on incomplete factor/date, quarantine and do not adjust on unverified or synthetic candidates, hold on conflicting revisions, and new artifacts plus publication lineage on factor correction.

guard_coverage_verified_before_promoting.method: Every one of the 34 family guard methods across all 17 families was checked to exist by name before any promotion was applied.
guard_coverage_verified_before_promoting.a_guess_that_was_wrong: The deterministic_oracle family initially named IndicatorIndependentOracleTest::test_indicator_vector_matches_the_independent_oracle, which does not exist. The check caught it and the family now names test_correction_oracle_propagates_by_exactly_the_expected_amount, a real method. Without the check this attempt would have bound a predicate to a guard nobody wrote.

proof_families_added.correction_recompute_lineage: MD-S012-R0032, MD-S012-R0033, MD-S083-R0051, MD-S083-R0052 - correction pipeline execution and the held-conflict path.
proof_families_added.deterministic_oracle: MD-S012-R0034 - independent oracle propagation plus revision-sensitive factor hashing.
proof_families_added.factor_provenance_vocabulary: MD-S083-R0006 and R0019 - the importer refuses unattributed and platform-derived provenance, and a price-derived factor never reaches the adjustment path.
proof_families_added.structural_adjustment_formula: MD-S083-R0038 - coherent compounding, with the future-factor exclusion proving the ex_date <= D bound.
proof_families_added.candidate_quarantine_boundary: MD-S083-R0049 and R0050 - an unattributed factor does not adjust, and a price-derived action does not suppress contamination.

rows_that_are_deliberately_not_promotion.principle: Section 7 forbids duplicating a closure obligation a REQUIRED row already owns. Several rows read like strong candidates and are not.
rows_that_are_deliberately_not_promotion.MD-S012 coherence bullets R0023 to R0027: The coherence obligation is owned by the REQUIRED MD-S083-R0039 and MD-S012-R0028. R0027 raw immutability is owned by MD-S083-R0054, promoted in MD-B12-A002.
rows_that_are_deliberately_not_promotion.MD-S012-R0007 and R0009: The binding components and the stored-state requirement are owned by the REQUIRED MD-S012-R0011 to R0017.
rows_that_are_deliberately_not_promotion.MD-S012-R0038: Acceptance criterion restating obligations owned by the REQUIRED MD-S083-R0069 and MD-S083-R0053.
rows_that_are_deliberately_not_promotion.wrapped fragments: MD-S083-R0014, R0016, R0018, R0020, R0021 are continuation lines of sentences whose heads are REQUIRED or promoted here.
rows_that_are_deliberately_not_promotion.capability and enumeration rows: MD-S083-R0043 to R0047 enumerate what the detector may emit and state its limit; MD-S083-R0065 to R0067 are what the product cannot prove, and R0067 says outright it is a restatement of a prohibition already owned.

review_pass_guards.completeness_is_absolute_here: Unlike A002 this pass is not partial, so it aborts if any non-structural MD-B12 reference row is left neither promoted nor decided. That is the condition for admitting the stage to DECISION_RECORDED_STAGES, checked in the pass rather than assumed at admission.
review_pass_guards.falsifiability_completeness: Removing MD-S083-R0067 from A003_REFERENCE_DECISIONS made the pass abort with that row reported unaccounted for.
review_pass_guards.falsifiability_foreign_rows: Injecting a mutation on MD-S011-R0023, a MD-B11 row, made the pass abort naming it and its owning stage.
review_pass_guards.named_rules_reached: The pass aborts when a named promotion or decision is never reached, so a typo cannot silently shrink the scope.
review_pass_guards.start_state_verified: A promoted rule must have been REFERENCE_ONLY beforehand, so a no-op cannot look like work.

test_execution.database: MariaDB 10.4.27 reachable; tradeaxis and tradeaxis_testing both at 80 migrations and 73 tables

residue_verdict.verdict_vocabulary: One of the five states enumerated by IMPLEMENTATION_RESIDUE_AND_CONFORMANCE_STANDARD.md; scope is a separate field.
residue_verdict.scope: The MD-S012 version/change rule, the MD-S083 provenance, revision, formula and contamination sections, and the MD-B12 review and proof tooling.
residue_verdict.basis: No application source, migration, configuration, or stored business row was altered. No new guard was needed: every promoted predicate is proven by a guard that already existed and was verified to exist by name.

runtime_artifact_boundary.note: The database is reachable and the suite exercises it, but this attempt writes no business row and requires no external raw artifact of its own.

open_items_after: MD-B11-A003 owns 167 non-structural reference rows and is the last closed-stage backlog.
1384 rows remain across eleven unopened stages, to be resolved at each stage entry under MD-DEP-0004.
The residue-vocabulary deviation reported in E-MD-B11-A002-001 is unchanged and no gate validates the vocabulary.
GlobalConvergenceClosureTest::test_no_test_expects_a_synthetic_verified_factor still ends with assertTrue(true) and can pass vacuously.
Every stage normalization other than MD-B07 and MD-B08 still carries the unguarded clearing code that can unbind another stage proof.
